title: LookaheadDelay — circular buffer, setLatencySamples, click-free changes
description:
Implement optional global lookahead delay with exact host-reported latency per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §19.2.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §19.1–19.2 (default 0 samples; optional 0.5/1/2/5 ms; report exact latency; live profiles default off; no hidden latency)
- Source/PluginProcessor.* latency APIs only as reference for future wiring (read only; h.5 calls setLatencySamples)
- Sibling Source/DSP/* circular-buffer or delay patterns if any (read only)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h lookahead mode enum if present (read only)
- CMakeLists.txt (read only; h.5 owns registration)

Implement Source/DSP/LookaheadDelay.h and Source/DSP/LookaheadDelay.cpp:
1. Preallocated circular buffer sized at prepare for maximum mode (5 ms at max supported sample rate) × channels; no runtime heap growth.
2. Modes: Off, 0.5 ms, 1 ms, 2 ms, 5 ms. Map mode → delaySamples = round(ms * sampleRate / 1000). Off ⇒ 0 samples delay and pass-through.
3. process: delay all channels identically (stereo main; design for ≥2 channels). Dry path when Off is true bypass (copy or in-place no-op with zero extra latency).
4. getLatencySamples() returns the exact integer delay currently applied (0 when Off). h.5 will call AudioProcessor::setLatencySamples with this value — document the contract in the header.
5. Click-free delay changes: crossfade, overlap-add short crossfade, or equivalent when mode/delay changes; clear or fade residual state on reset/prepare; no zipper clicks from abrupt read-index jumps.
6. setMode / setDelayMilliseconds APIs with clamp to allowed set; prepare(sampleRate, maxBlockSize, numChannels); reset() clears buffer to zeros.
7. Audio-thread safe: no locksaggingque, no allocations in process.
8. No PluginProcessor setLatencySamples call in this task (module only reports latency). No M/S, sidechain, tests, or CMakeLists changes.

C++20/JUCE style consistent with Source/. verification_commands left empty.
acceptance_criteria: LookaheadDelay supports Off, 0.5, 1, 2, and 5 ms modes with preallocated circular buffer sized at prepare
getLatencySamples() returns exact integer delay (0 when Off) for host PDC via future setLatencySamples
Mode/delay changes are click-free (crossfade or equivalent); reset clears delay memory
Off mode is true bypass with zero samples latency; process is allocation-free
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: fixed std::vector or AudioBuffer circular storage allocated in prepare
enum class LookaheadMode { Off, Ms0_5, Ms1, Ms2, Ms5 }
equal-power or linear crossfade on delay change
integer sample delay from rounded ms*sr/1000
forbidden: fractional delay interpolation requirement beyond integer circular delay unless needed for click-free crossfade only
